findings.title: fetch_error_details misaligns error IDs to nodestore data
findings.body: In fetch_error_details the code builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids) which returns a dict keyed by node_id, then does zip(error_ids, events.values()). Dict values order is not guaranteed to match error_ids order, and if any node is missing the lengths differ so zip truncates and shifts. The result pairs the wrong event_id with the wrong title/message/timestamp, sending incorrect error context to Seer and misattributing errors.

findings.title: age/timestamp mutual-exclusion check fails for 0 values
findings.body: validate_timestamp uses if self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age uses if self.initial_data.get("timestamp"). When age is 0 or timestamp is 0 the .get() value is falsy, so a report containing both age and timestamp passes validation. Age 0 (fresh report) and timestamp 0 are legal values, so mixed-spec reports that should be rejected with 422 will be accepted, and neither field is required so reports with neither also pass.

findings.title: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template references undefined PRCommentWorkflow
findings.body: CommitContextIntegration.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title) but _truncate_title is defined as a staticmethod on CommitContextIntegration in this file. PRCommentWorkflow is not the class that defines it (and is not imported in the shown context), so calling the merged-PR comment path raises AttributeError/NameError and breaks suspect-issue PR comments for GitHub and GitLab.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature-flag/permission check
findings.body: ProjectPreprodArtifactAssembleEndpoint.post calls analytics.record(preprod_artifact.api.assemble) before checking organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble and before validating the body. Disabled, unauthorized, or malformed requests are therefore counted as assemble attempts, inflating metrics and recording user_id/organization_id/project_id for requests that should have been rejected with 404/400.

findings.title: Table widget visualization renders empty data behind flag
findings.body: When organization.features includes use-table-widget-visualization the code renders <TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data:[], meta:{fields:{},units:{}}}} /> instead of passing the actual result.meta, result.data, fields and renderers used by StyledSimpleTableChart. Enabling the flag replaces every dashboard table with an empty table, losing all query results.

findings.title: Column fallback crashes when meta.fields is missing
findings.body: The fallback columnOrder does Object.keys(tableData?.meta.fields). If tableData is undefined or meta/fields is undefined (empty result, loading, or error shape), this throws TypeError: Cannot convert undefined to object and crashes the widget. It should guard with fallback to empty array, e.g. Object.keys(tableData?.meta?.fields ?? {}).
